control.description-key: Shows the activity history of the current record as a GitHub-style contribution graph, aggregated by day, week, month or year

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Bind to any existing field on the form so the control can be added. Its value is never read or changed - the graph always shows the history of the whole record.

property.name: source
property.description-key: What counts as activity. Audit history needs auditing turned on for the environment and the table, and the View Audit History privilege.

value.name: Audit
value.description-key: Changes from the audit log: creates, updates, assigns, shares and deletes of this record

value.name: Activities
value.description-key: Activities (emails, phone calls, tasks, appointments and custom activities) regarding this record

value.name: All
value.description-key: Audit history, related activities and notes together

property.name: activityDate
property.description-key: Which date places a related activity in the graph. Only used for related activities.

value.name: CreatedOn
value.description-key: The date the activity was created

value.name: CompletedOn
value.description-key: The actual end date of a completed activity, or its created on date while it is still open

property.name: aggregation
property.description-key: What one square of the graph stands for.

value.name: Day
value.description-key: One square per day, in week columns with a row per weekday - the GitHub contribution graph

value.name: Week
value.description-key: One square per week, one row per year

value.name: Month
value.description-key: One square per month, one row per year

property.name: yearsToShow
property.description-key: How many calendar years to show, newest first. 0 (default) is automatic: the last 12 months for Day, and every year since the record was created (up to 10) for Week, Month and Year.

property.name: firstDayOfWeek
property.description-key: The weekday each week column or week square starts on. Monday by default; Automatic uses the first day of the week from the user personal settings.

value.name: Auto
value.description-key: The first day of the week from the user personal settings

property.name: showDetails
property.description-key: If true (default), clicking a square opens a callout listing the changes, activities or notes in it.

property.name: showSummary
property.description-key: If true (default), shows the total above the graph, for example 214 changes in the last year.

property.name: showLegend
property.description-key: If true (default), shows the Less to More color scale below the graph.

property.name: cellShape
property.description-key: The corner shape of each square.

value.name: Rounded
value.description-key: Slightly rounded corners, as on GitHub

property.name: colorScheme
property.description-key: The colors of the five activity levels.

value.name: Blue
value.description-key: The blue of the LegalTechOps field controls

value.name: Halloween
value.description-key: Yellow to orange to near-black, the GitHub Halloween graph

value.name: Heat
value.description-key: Yellow to orange to dark red

value.name: Ocean
value.description-key: Light green to teal to deep blue

value.name: Custom
value.description-key: Shades of the Custom Color below

property.name: customColor
property.description-key: Hex color (for example #8250DF) for the busiest squares when Color Scheme is Custom. Quieter squares use lighter shades of it.
